Thanks for your interest in Redwood Inference — I’m Monica on the recruiting team. We’re excited about your background and I’d love to set up a brief 20-minute phone screen to learn more about your recent work and share a bit about the role.

I wanted to propose a couple of short windows that try to avoid a late-night or very-early slot for you (I realize we span a few timezones):

- Option A: Tue, Oct 27 — 10:00–10:20 PT / 18:00–18:20 CEST
- Option B: Wed, Oct 28 — 07:30–07:50 PT / 15:30–15:50 CEST

If neither works, feel free to send two alternative 20-minute slots that suit your morning/evening and I’ll loop in the hiring manager. Also let me know which phone number you prefer or if you’d like a Zoom link.

Quick note on agenda (20m):
- 5–7m: intro & background
- 8–10m: role expectations / product context
- 3–5m: next steps / logistics

Look forward to hearing which slot works.

Best,
